falseNegatives.description: The canvas dot grid is offset by about 10px horizontally and 2–3px vertically in code (dots are painted on the inner flow surface, not the canvas), so dots land in different places and touch some labels such as "approved ↓ continues"
falseNegatives.note: [dot-grid-offset] background-image moves from the canvas (design) to the absolutely positioned flow layer (code)

falseNegatives.description: Below the visible area (seen after scrolling): after the Verdict gate branch rejoins, code adds an extra ~42px connector, so Publish preview and everything after it sits 41–42px lower than in the design
falseNegatives.note: [merge-gap] code pads the branch join by 42px; design joins straight onto the next card

falseNegatives.description: Below the visible area: the Ship it? card is 269px wide in code vs 248px, and its title stretches so "upcoming · blocking ask" is pushed to the card's right edge instead of following the title
